verdict.rationale: Yapily documents an official MCP server that agents like Claude or Cursor can connect to, and a probe confirms the page exists. However, the docs describe it only as a live, searchable connection to the documentation, not to the payments or financial-data APIs. missing for 10: MCP tools exposing Yapily API operations (accounts, transactions, payments), auth/setup details for the MCP endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
